ownerHome.heading: Stop taking bookings on WhatsApp
ownerHome.body: Register your ground, let players book the slots themselves, sell at the counter, and see what the night made — without a notebook or a phone that never stops.
ownerHome.heroNote: No monthly fee. A commission on what you actually take, and nothing on a night the ground sits empty.
ownerHome.registerBody: Three steps, with a review in between — the reason players trust what they find here.
ownerHome.step1Body: Name, area, how many grounds and what each one is for. Photographs of the pitch, not a logo.
ownerHome.step2Body: Your identity, and that the ground is what the photographs say. This is the step that keeps the listing worth being in.
ownerHome.step3Body: Open and close per day, price bands for peak and off-peak. Players book inside them; you confirm, or let it confirm itself.
ownerHome.counterTitle: The counter, not a cash box
ownerHome.counterBody: Water, balls, bibs, a jersey on loan. Ring it up on the same screen that holds the booking, and the shelf counts itself down.
ownerHome.counterPoint1: Sell from stock that knows what is left
ownerHome.counterPoint2: Hand out gear and get it back, counted separately
ownerHome.counterPoint3: Cash or online, against the booking it belongs to
ownerHome.receiptStockNote: Two bottles and a ball came off the shelf. The bibs are out until somebody brings them back.
ownerHome.upkeepTitle: The parts that are not a sale
ownerHome.upkeepBody: A turf runs on people, and on the nights it is shut. Both belong in the same place as the bookings, or neither gets done.
ownerHome.upkeepPoint1: Invite a manager or a cashier — they sign in with their own account
ownerHome.upkeepPoint2: Shut a ground for resurfacing and it stops taking bookings
ownerHome.upkeepPoint3: Takings, commission and payouts, per period
ownerHome.upkeepClosedNote: Nobody can book those nights, and nobody has to be told.
ownerHome.closeTitle: Put your ground where players are looking
ownerHome.closeBody: Registering takes a few minutes. The review takes longer, and it is why a player who finds your turf here actually turns up.
